headword: {大盤振|おおばんぶ}る{舞|ま}い

definitions.gloss: lavish spending; generous treat; extravagant hospitality
definitions.explanation: An act of spending generously or treating people lavishly, especially when hosting a feast or giving gifts. Can be positive (genuine generosity) or slightly critical (excessive spending).

examples.japanese: ⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{大盤振|おおばんぶ}る{舞|ま}い⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{全員|ぜんいん}→全員：03310_zenin⟧⟦{招待|しょうたい}→招待：01435_shoutai⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Everyone was invited thanks to the president's generous treat.

examples.japanese: ⟦ボーナス→ボーナス：05878_boonasu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}て→出る：00513_deru⟧、{大盤振|おおばんぶ}る{舞|ま}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{食事会|しょくじかい}→食事会：23547_shokujikai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}いた→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: After getting my bonus, I threw a lavish dinner party.

examples.japanese: ⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{選挙前|せんきょまえ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{大盤振|おおばんぶ}る{舞|ま}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{政策|せいさく}→政策：10070_seisaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打|う}ち{出|だ}す→打ち出す：06790_uchidasu⟧⟦{傾向|けいこう}→傾向：02695_keikou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The government tends to announce generous spending policies before elections.

notes:
Originally referred to serving food on a large tray ({大盤|おおばん}) in a grand manner (⟦{振|ふ}る{舞|ま}い→振る舞う：04233_furumau⟧, a feast or banquet). Now used more broadly for any lavish or generous spending or entertaining.

USAGE:
Can carry either a positive nuance (admiring someone's generosity) or a slightly negative one (implying reckless or politically motivated spending), depending on context.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {大盤振|おおばんぶ}る{舞|ま}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to spend lavishly, to treat generously
- {大盤振|おおばんぶ}る{舞|ま}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧～: a lavish ~

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{奮発|ふんぱつ}→奮発：15756_funpatsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to splurge — deciding to spend more than usual on a particular purchase
- ⟦{散財|さんざい}→散財：09233_sanzai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to spend freely — often implies wasting money
- ⟦{気前|きまえ}がいい→気前がいい：20378_kimaegaii⟧: generous — a personality trait rather than a specific act
